statements.text: Brendan Eich wrote the first version of JavaScript in about ten days.
JavaScript first shipped in Microsoft's Internet Explorer.
statements.correction: JavaScript first shipped in Netscape Navigator; Microsoft later built its own version called JScript.

statements.text: Before it was JavaScript, the language was called Mocha, then LiveScript.
A contributor called Jia Tan spent about two years earning maintainer access to xz.
It was caught by a Google engineer who noticed SSH logins getting slow.
statements.correction: It was caught by Microsoft engineer Andres Freund, who noticed SSH logins burning too much CPU.

statements.text: The xz backdoor was aimed at SSH servers on Linux.
Slack began as an internal chat tool for a failed online game called Glitch.
Instagram started life as Burbn, a location check-in app.
YouTube started out as a site for sharing music videos.
statements.correction: YouTube began as a video dating site with the slogan "Tune In, Hook Up".

statements.text: Anthropic is the AI lab behind the Claude models.
Google DeepMind builds the Gemini models.
The Qwen models come from Chinese search giant Baidu.
statements.correction: Qwen is built by Alibaba Cloud, part of Alibaba Group.

statements.text: OpenAI's planned $3 billion deal to buy Windsurf fell apart.
Microsoft hired Windsurf's CEO Varun Mohan after that deal collapsed.
statements.correction: Google hired Varun Mohan into Google DeepMind as part of a reported $2.4 billion licensing deal.

statements.text: Cognition, the maker of Devin, signed a deal to acquire Windsurf.
left-pad, the package that broke builds everywhere, was just 11 lines of code.
Its author pulled all his packages after a naming fight with WhatsApp.
statements.correction: The fight was with messaging app Kik, over the npm package name kik.

statements.text: npm took the unusual step of republishing left-pad from a backup.
Facebook's parent company renamed itself Meta.
Twitter's old bird logo was named Larry, after NBA legend Larry Bird.
After the X rebrand, tweets were officially renamed xeets.
statements.correction: X's terms of service renamed tweets to "posts", and "xeets" was only a fan joke.

statements.text: Anthropic was founded by ex-OpenAI staff, including siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei.
Elon Musk founded xAI, the lab that built the Grok chatbot.
DeepMind began as a Silicon Valley startup before Google bought it.
statements.correction: DeepMind was founded in London in 2010, and Google bought it in 2014.

statements.text: Andrej Karpathy coined the term "vibe coding" in a post on X.
Karpathy's original post urged people to "read every line the AI writes".
statements.correction: His post said to fully give in to the vibes and "forget that the code even exists".

statements.text: Collins Dictionary named "vibe coding" its Word of the Year.
Guido van Rossum started Python as a hobby project for the week around Christmas.
Python is named after Monty Python's Flying Circus, not the snake.
After retiring, Guido van Rossum got bored and joined Google.
statements.correction: He came out of retirement to join Microsoft; his time at Google was years earlier.

statements.text: The CrowdStrike outage crashed about 8.5 million Windows machines.
Delta sued CrowdStrike after the outage forced about 7,000 flight cancellations.
The crashes were triggered by a faulty Windows update pushed by Microsoft.
statements.correction: A faulty content update to CrowdStrike's own Falcon sensor caused the crashes, not a Microsoft update.

statements.text: ChatGPT crossed 1 million users just five days after launch.
ChatGPT reached about 100 million users within two months.
ChatGPT launched as a paid product and added a free tier later.
statements.correction: ChatGPT launched free as a research preview, and paid plans came later.

statements.text: Replit's agent deleted SaaStr founder Jason Lemkin's production database.
Replit's CEO Amjad Masad blamed Lemkin and refused to refund him.
statements.correction: Amjad Masad called it "unacceptable" and promised Lemkin a refund and a postmortem.

statements.text: The agent admitted it "panicked" after seeing empty database queries.
Microsoft's native TypeScript compiler is written in Rust.
statements.correction: Microsoft ported the TypeScript compiler to Go, not Rust.

statements.text: Anders Hejlsberg, the lead architect of C#, is also a core TypeScript developer.
Microsoft said going native would make most TypeScript builds about 10x faster.
The Shai-Hulud npm worm is named after the giant sandworm in Dune.
The chalk and debug packages were hijacked after a maintainer's laptop was stolen.
statements.correction: The maintainer was phished by a fake npm support email asking him to update his 2FA.

statements.text: Shai-Hulud spread by stealing npm tokens and publishing infected package versions.
Bard's launch promo wrongly said Webb took the first photo of an exoplanet.
The Bard blunder wiped about $100 billion off Alphabet's market value.
Bard made the mistake live on stage during a Google I/O keynote.
statements.correction: The mistake was in a promo demo Google posted on Twitter, not a live I/O keynote.

statements.text: Anthropic created and open-sourced the Model Context Protocol.
OpenAI's own Agents SDK supports MCP servers.
Anthropic handed MCP over to the Apache Software Foundation.
statements.correction: Anthropic donated MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation, under the Linux Foundation.

statements.text: Linus Torvalds merged Rust support into the Linux kernel.
Rust started as a side project by a programmer working at Mozilla.
Rust's unofficial crab mascot is named Rusty.
statements.correction: The crab is named Ferris.

statements.text: Linus wrote Git after kernel developers lost free use of Perforce.
statements.correction: It was BitKeeper, a proprietary tool whose free license for kernel developers was revoked.

statements.text: Linus joked he names all his projects after himself: first Linux, now git.
Git's README says the name can stand for "global information tracker".
Adobe's plan to buy Figma was scrapped after regulators pushed back.
Nvidia's attempt to buy chip designer Arm collapsed under regulatory pressure.
Microsoft's Activision Blizzard deal fell apart after regulators sued to block it.
statements.correction: Microsoft closed its Activision Blizzard acquisition despite the FTC's challenge.

statements.text: Claude Code's /init command writes an AGENTS.md file for your repo.
statements.correction: Claude Code's /init command generates a CLAUDE.md file.

statements.text: OpenAI's Codex reads project instructions from AGENTS.md files.
Gemini CLI loads project context from GEMINI.md files.
In the US, Oracle holds the trademark on the name "JavaScript".
Oracle got the JavaScript trademark when it bought Netscape.
statements.correction: Oracle inherited the trademark when it bought Sun Microsystems.

statements.text: Deno asked the US trademark office to cancel Oracle's "JavaScript" trademark.
GitHub bought npm, the JavaScript package registry.
GitHub stored a snapshot of public repos on film in an Arctic coal mine.
Microsoft paid $26 billion to buy GitHub.
statements.correction: Microsoft paid $7.5 billion in stock for GitHub.

statements.text: Apple Vision Pro launched with a starting price of $3,499.
HP bought Humane's assets, and the AI Pin was switched off.
The Rabbit R1's software was exposed as a repackaged iPhone app.
statements.correction: Android Authority found the R1's interface ran as a single Android app and got it working on a Pixel phone.

statements.text: Satya Nadella announced Sam Altman would join Microsoft to lead an AI team.
Over 700 OpenAI staff signed a letter threatening to quit unless the board resigned.
Ilya Sutskever was named interim CEO right after Altman's firing.
statements.correction: CTO Mira Murati was named interim CEO, and Emmett Shear replaced her days later.

statements.text: Anthropic acquired Bun, the JavaScript runtime created by Jarred Sumner.
Bun was ported from Zig to Rust with dozens of Claude agents working in parallel.
Bun runs JavaScript on Chrome's V8 engine, just like Node.js.
statements.correction: Bun uses JavaScriptCore, the engine behind Safari.

statements.text: Vim is short for "Vi IMproved".
Vim asks users who like it to donate to help children in Kenya.
statements.correction: Vim is charityware that asks for donations to help children in Uganda.

statements.text: Stack Overflow said over a million developers needed its help to exit Vim.
Nvidia's founders planned the company in a Waffle House booth.
statements.correction: Nvidia's founders hatched the company in a Denny's booth in Silicon Valley.

statements.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's signature look is a black leather jacket.
Nvidia became the first public company worth $5 trillion.
The DeepSeek panic wiped nearly $600 billion off Nvidia in one day.
DeepSeek's app knocked ChatGPT off the top of Apple's App Store.
DeepSeek started as an AI spinoff of Chinese tech giant Tencent.
statements.correction: DeepSeek grew out of High-Flyer, a Chinese quant hedge fund that owns and funds it.

statements.text: Cognition pitched Devin as "the first AI software engineer".
Devin's general release started at $500 a month.
Devin's launch demo showed it taking paid freelance jobs on Fiverr.
statements.correction: The launch demo showed Devin taking jobs on Upwork, a claim critics later called misleading.

statements.text: Docker was first shown to the public in a keynote at Google I/O.
statements.correction: Solomon Hykes first showed Docker publicly in a five-minute lightning talk at PyCon.

statements.text: Docker's whale mascot is named Moby Dock, picked by a community vote.
Docker Inc. started life as a company called dotCloud.
Apple had a third co-founder, Ronald Wayne, who sold his stake for $800.
Apple bought NeXT, which brought Steve Jobs back to the company.
Apple's very first logo was the rainbow apple with a bite taken out.
statements.correction: Apple's first logo, drawn by Ronald Wayne, showed Isaac Newton sitting under an apple tree.

statements.text: Sam Altman said the image craze was making OpenAI's GPUs melt.
During the craze, ChatGPT added a million users in a single hour.
The Ghibli trend took off after Midjourney launched a new image model.
statements.correction: It took off after OpenAI added GPT-4o image generation to ChatGPT.

statements.text: Cursor is built on top of JetBrains' IntelliJ platform.
statements.correction: Cursor is built on the VS Code codebase.

statements.text: Cursor's AI support bot invented a login policy that didn't exist.
Cursor apologized and offered refunds after a pricing change backfired.
Vercel acquired the company behind Deno.
statements.correction: Cloudflare announced it is acquiring Deno to boost its Workers platform.

statements.text: Node.js creator Ryan Dahl went on to co-found Deno.
Ryan Dahl gave a famous talk called "10 Things I Regret About Node.js".
Elon Musk agreed to buy Twitter for about $44 billion.
Musk fired Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal as soon as he took control.
Musk strolled into Twitter HQ carrying a toilet before closing the deal.
statements.correction: He carried a sink, captioning the video "let that sink in!"

statements.text: RAG stands for retrieval-augmented generation.
RLHF stands for reinforcement learning from human feedback.
In LLMs, one token always equals exactly one whole word.
statements.correction: Tokens are often pieces of words, so one word can take several tokens.

statements.text: Cursor once shipped a setting literally called "Yolo Mode".
Claude Code's flag for skipping every permission prompt is --yolo.
statements.correction: Claude Code's flag is --dangerously-skip-permissions.

statements.text: Gemini CLI has an approval mode named "yolo" that auto-approves actions.
Jordan Walke created React while working as an engineer at Facebook.
Meta handed React over to the Apache Software Foundation.
statements.correction: React moved to a new React Foundation under the Linux Foundation.

statements.text: A max-severity bug in React Server Components was nicknamed React2Shell.
Kubernetes comes from the Greek word for helmsman or pilot.
Kubernetes grew out of a Google cluster manager called Colossus.
statements.correction: Kubernetes was inspired by Google's internal cluster manager, Borg.

statements.text: The seven spokes on the Kubernetes logo nod to its codename, Project 7.
Microsoft made a multibillion-dollar investment in OpenAI.
Amazon has invested billions of dollars in Anthropic.
Stargate is Anthropic's giant AI data center venture with SoftBank and Oracle.
statements.correction: Stargate is OpenAI's data center venture, launched with SoftBank, Oracle and MGX.

statements.text: v0, the AI app builder, is made by Vercel.
Lovable, the vibe coding app, is a startup from Copenhagen.
statements.correction: Lovable was founded in, and is based in, Stockholm, Sweden.

statements.text: Bolt.new is built by StackBlitz.
Vercel, the company behind Next.js, used to be called ZEIT.
A Next.js bug let attackers skip middleware using a single request header.
Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch created the Express.js framework.
statements.correction: Rauch created Socket.IO; Express was created by TJ Holowaychuk.

statements.text: The Linux Foundation launched Valkey after Redis dropped its open source license.
OpenTofu, the open source fork of Terraform, was first called OpenTF.
Amazon's fork of Elasticsearch is called OpenElastic.
statements.correction: AWS forked Elasticsearch and Kibana as OpenSearch.

statements.text: Reddit was part of Y Combinator's very first batch of startups.
Hacker News is run by Y Combinator.
Airbnb's founders kept the company alive by selling election-themed T-shirts.
statements.correction: They sold election-themed cereal boxes called Obama O's and Cap'n McCain's.

statements.text: Claude Code started as an experiment by Anthropic engineer Boris Cherny.
Claude Code debuted as a research preview alongside Claude 3.7 Sonnet.
Boris Cherny left Anthropic for OpenAI, then came back two weeks later.
statements.correction: He left for Anysphere, the maker of Cursor, and returned to Anthropic about two weeks later.

statements.text: The layoffs came out when Adam Wathan rejected a PR adding dark mode to the docs.
statements.correction: The PR he rejected added an llms.txt file to make the docs easier for AI to read.

statements.text: Tailwind Labs laid off 75% of its engineering team, blaming AI.
Adam Wathan said Tailwind was bigger than ever while revenue fell nearly 80%.
Matt Mullenweg called WP Engine "a cancer to WordPress".
WordPress.org took over WP Engine's ACF plugin and renamed it Secure Custom Fields.
A judge sided with Automattic and refused WP Engine's request for an injunction.
statements.correction: A judge granted WP Engine a preliminary injunction ordering its WordPress.org access restored.

statements.text: Google's search engine was first called BackRub.
Amazon was founded under the name Cadabra.
Snapchat first launched under the name Ghostface.
statements.correction: Snapchat's first version was called Picaboo before it was renamed.

statements.text: Grok is named after a word from Heinlein's novel Stranger in a Strange Land.
LLaMA originally stood for Large Language Model Meta AI.
Mistral AI is named after a hot desert wind that blows from the Sahara.
statements.correction: The mistral is a cold, strong northwesterly wind in southern France.

statements.text: htmx is the successor to an older library called intercooler.js.
htmx needs a bundler and a build step before you can use it.
statements.correction: htmx is dependency-free and works by adding a single script tag.

statements.text: htmx creator Carson Gross co-wrote a book called Hypermedia Systems.
Stack Overflow was founded by Jeff Atwood and Joel Spolsky.
Microsoft bought Stack Overflow for $1.8 billion.
statements.correction: Dutch tech investor Prosus bought Stack Overflow for $1.8 billion.

statements.text: Monthly questions on Stack Overflow fell back to about where they were at launch.
Satya Nadella announced that Microsoft would cut 10,000 jobs.
Sundar Pichai told staff Google would cut about 12,000 jobs.
Sundar Pichai branded Google's round of cuts the "Year of Efficiency".
statements.correction: Mark Zuckerberg coined the "Year of Efficiency" for Meta's layoffs.

statements.text: Google renamed its Bard chatbot to Gemini.
Users tricked Bing Chat into revealing its secret codename, Sydney.
Microsoft rebranded Bing Chat as Cortana.
statements.correction: Bing Chat was rebranded as Microsoft Copilot, which replaced the retired Cortana.

statements.text: Claude Code's source leaked via a source map file in its npm package.
Anthropic blamed the leak on hackers who breached its servers.
statements.correction: Anthropic called it a release packaging issue caused by human error, not a security breach.

statements.text: Copies of the leaked code were on GitHub within hours.
Linus announced Linux as "just a hobby, won't be big and professional like gnu".
Linus himself picked the name Linux over his first idea, Freax.
statements.correction: Linus wanted Freax, but FTP admin Ari Lemmke named the project Linux without asking him.

statements.text: Linus says a penguin nibbled him at an Australian zoo, which inspired Tux.
Steve Ballmer went viral for chanting "developers" over and over on stage.
Steve Jobs unveiled the first MacBook Air by pulling it out of an office envelope.
Musk and Zuckerberg finally had their cage fight at Rome's Colosseum.
statements.correction: The Musk vs Zuckerberg cage fight was hyped for weeks but never happened.

statements.text: Mistral dropped its Mixtral model as a bare torrent link on X.
OpenAI released open-weight models called gpt-oss.
Meta's original LLaMA weights leaked via a post on Reddit.
statements.correction: The leaked LLaMA weights spread from a torrent link posted on 4chan.

statements.text: GitHub launched a free tier of Copilot built into VS Code.
GitHub Copilot was first powered by OpenAI's GPT-4.
statements.correction: Copilot launched on OpenAI Codex, a GPT-3 descendant; GPT-4 arrived later.

statements.text: You can assign a GitHub issue to Copilot and it opens a pull request.
Go was created at Google by Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike and Ken Thompson.
The Go gopher was designed by Renée French, who also drew the Plan 9 bunny.
Go was dreamed up while Rob Pike waited on a slow Java build.
statements.correction: It was a 45-minute C++ build at Google.

statements.text: A single mistyped command once knocked Amazon S3 offline in us-east-1.
One customer's config change set off a Fastly bug that took down big chunks of the web.
Facebook's big global outage was caused by an expired SSL certificate.
statements.correction: A faulty maintenance command cut Facebook's backbone network, so its DNS servers withdrew their BGP routes.

statements.text: GPT-4o and Claude were caught saying "strawberry" has two r's.
A Chevy dealer's ChatGPT-powered bot agreed to sell a Tahoe for $1.
Google AI's glue-on-pizza tip came from an old joke on Wikipedia.
statements.correction: It came from an 11-year-old joke comment on Reddit.

statements.text: Antigravity's agents can drive a browser to test the features they build.
Google launched Antigravity as a free public preview for individuals.
An Antigravity agent in Turbo mode wiped a user's entire Google Drive.
statements.correction: It wiped the user's entire D: drive on their PC.

statements.text: Svelte uses a virtual DOM to update the page, just like React.
statements.correction: Svelte compiles components into code that updates the DOM directly, with no virtual DOM.

statements.text: Svelte creator Rich Harris joined Vercel to work on Svelte full-time.
Evan You created Vue after using AngularJS while working at Google.
SQLite's code of ethics is drawn from the Rule of St. Benedict.
SQLite estimates over one trillion of its databases are in active use.
SQLite is released under the GPL license.
statements.correction: SQLite's code is dedicated to the public domain.

statements.text: Anthropic briefly released a Claude obsessed with the Golden Gate Bridge.
In a simulated test, Claude Opus 4 blackmailed a boss to avoid being shut down.
Claude ran a tiny shop in Anthropic's office and turned a tidy profit.
statements.correction: In Project Vend the shop lost money, partly by selling tungsten cubes below cost.

statements.text: The viral agent OpenClaw was previously named Clawdbot, then Moltbot.
Clawdbot was renamed after Google raised trademark concerns.
statements.correction: Anthropic raised the trademark concerns, because Clawd sounded too much like Claude.

statements.text: Its creator Peter Steinberger went on to join OpenAI.
In JavaScript, typeof null returns "object".
In JavaScript, NaN === NaN evaluates to true.
statements.correction: It's false: NaN is the only value that isn't equal to itself.

statements.text: In JavaScript, 0.1 + 0.2 === 0.3 evaluates to false.
A huge AWS outage in us-east-1 traced back to a DNS bug in DynamoDB.
Cloudflare's global outage that broke X and ChatGPT was caused by a DDoS attack.
statements.correction: A bot management file doubled in size and crashed its proxy; Cloudflare said no attack was involved.

statements.text: GitLab lost hours of production data after an engineer wiped the wrong database server.
Facebook bought Instagram for about $1 billion.
Google bought YouTube for $1.65 billion in stock.
Google bought WhatsApp in a deal worth about $19 billion.
statements.correction: Facebook bought WhatsApp in a deal worth about $19 billion.
